title: Lusin decomposition of (M, θ) into compact pieces with continuous weight (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let V ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, M ⊆ V Hⁿ-null-measurable, θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ with θ > 0 on M and θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ V. Then there are sets C_k ⊆ ℝ^Q (k ∈ ℕ) such that each C_k is compact, C_k ⊆ M, θ|C_k is continuous, Hⁿ(C_k) < ∞, and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_k C_k) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (V M : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ), IsOpen V → M ⊆ V → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl Q), (∀ k, IsCompact (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, C k ⊆ M) ∧ (∀ k, ContinuousOn θ (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C k) < ∞) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (M \ ⋃ k, C k) = 0
